dog.description_text:
Georgia is your typical hound. Talkative, lovable, ball of fluff. With her goofy grin, puppy eyes, and droopy ears she can win over anyone in seconds. Whether she's chasing after her favorite toy, rolling around in the grass, tracking all scents that have crossed her path or simply curling up on the couch to nap after a long day, Georgia is always full of personality and joy. She’s got a knack for making every day an adventure.

This cutie resides at our Westhampton location . If you are interested in meeting them, click "Apply for Adoption" to submit an online application. If you're viewing this animal on Petfinder, please visit the animal's page on Bideawee.org and click on the "Apply for Adoption" button to submit an adoption application. Prior to adoption, all of our animals are spayed/neutered, microchipped and given their age-appropriate vaccines.
